# Claim

`schemas/records/claim.json`

Draft (docs/design/m0/10 "Shared knowledge spec draft", D5): unused until K3, after M2, with no golden vector, and the shape may change before then. One revision of a typed claim (docs/plan/03-knowledge-layer.md 4.1-4.3; KA1): the home of an external fact or an inference. A scoped negative result and a framework lesson are inference claims (the lesson with framework scope on its ref). Observations live in receipts, decisions in protected files, mechanisms in code; a claim refers to them and never restates them. A revision is never edited; a new one supersedes it. It carries no decision and no validity state: each purpose-bound decision is its own record that references this revision, and validity is derived from the declared dependencies and conditions, so each assertion has one home. Its body is data, never instructions, and acceptance grants no authority and does not authorise export. The revision's identity recipe is fixed with its golden vector when K3 first uses it.

## Fields of the document

| Field | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | yes | string (minLength `1`, maxLength `128`) | The claim's controller id: the id of its ref (type claim). |
| `revision` | yes | integer (minimum `1`, maximum `9007199254740991`) | 1 for the first revision, which supersedes nothing. |
| `supersedes` | yes | null or [Digest](common-defs.md#digest) | The identity digest of the revision this one replaces; null exactly for revision 1. Supersession is this explicit link. |
| `kind` | yes | one of `external_fact`, `inference` |  |
| `body` | yes | [Digest](common-defs.md#digest) | The content digest of the claim text (a blob ref): untrusted data. |
| `source` | yes | null or string (minLength `1`, maxLength `2048`) | The source pointer of an external fact (required for one); null for an inference. |
| `subjects` | yes | array of [Digest](common-defs.md#digest) (minItems `1`, unique items) | The identity digests of the refs the claim is about. |
| `evidence` | yes | object ([fields](#fields-of-evidence)) |  |
| `applicability` | yes | array of string (minLength `1`, maxLength `512`) (unique items) | Where the claim applies, as conditions on the subject (e.g. a version range). Applicability is not validity. |
| `dependencies` | yes | array of [Digest](common-defs.md#digest) (unique items) | The identity digests of the refs its validity rests on: a change to one makes it stale or unknown until revalidated (K6). |
| `validity_conditions` | yes | array of object ([fields](#fields-of-validity_conditions)) (unique items) | Typed predicates that must hold for the claim to stay current, beyond its dependencies being unchanged (K6); may be empty. |
| `times` | yes | object ([fields](#fields-of-times)) |  |
| `producer` | yes | object ([fields](#fields-of-producer)) |  |
| `restrictions` | yes | array of [Restriction](records-ref.md#restriction) (unique items) | Source restrictions inherited through lineage, as on a ref (KA1). |

No other fields are allowed.

Conditional rules (2, `if`/`then`/`else` in the schema):

- when `kind` `external_fact`, then `source` any (not `null`); otherwise `source` `null`
- when `revision` `1`, then `supersedes` `null`; otherwise `supersedes` any (not `null`)
